text: Handling deadlines well starts with good time management. First, break large tasks into smaller steps and set a clear schedule. Next, prioritise your work: finish the most important or urgent tasks before less critical ones. Scope management is also essential, so be realistic about what you can complete and avoid adding extra work at the last minute. Finally, communicate early if a problem appears. Tell your teacher, manager, or team members honestly about your progress and ask for help when necessary. With planning, focus, and clear communication, you can meet deadlines, reduce stress, and produce better results.
